Givers.Name: Iris Moon
Givers.Greeting: The static has been loud tonight. Somebody always needs a door closed, and doors never close themselves.

Quests.Title: First Walk Behind the Veil
Quests.Summary: Iris Moon wants to see how you walk where the light bends. Cross the Veil in the park south of her shop, gather the lumen motes drifting there, and learn what a Hollow Shade looks like before one learns what you taste like.
Quests.Done: You walked the Inner World and came back with all your shadows attached. Iris called that a pass.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: You hold the Third Eye like a man holding a live wire. Charming. Let's teach you to hold it like a key.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Where does the key go?

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Behind everything. Meet me in the park. Hold the Eye until the world turns over, and I'll keep the door from closing on your fingers.

Steps.Objective: Go to the park south of Iris Moon's shop.
Hold the Third Eye to cross into the Inner World.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon (voice)
Lines.Text: Breathe. The ground is lying to you, but kindly. I'm holding the Veil open, so take your time.

Steps.Name: MOTES
Steps.Prompt: Press E to gather the mote
Steps.Objective: Gather the four lumen motes drifting in the park.
Steps.Text: The mote melts into your palm. It tastes like a memory of sugar.

Steps.Objective: A Hollow Shade is drifting closer. Read it with the Third Eye.
Destroy the Hollow Shades.
Hold the Third Eye again to step back into the Outer City.
Return to Iris Moon.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: You came back with all your shadows attached. That's a pass.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Is it always that quiet in there?

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Never. You just haven't learned to hear it yet. Give it time. Or don't, and stay sane.

FailIf.Message: You slipped back through the Veil and the motes faded.

Quests.Title: Three Tears in the Static
Quests.Summary: Three rifts have torn open along the dead frequencies, spitting Hollows into the Outer City. Close them one by one, from the Static Saints Tavern to the cemetery, before the static turns into a scream.
Quests.Done: Three rifts closed. The city sleeps better and has no idea why. Iris says that is the job.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Three tears. One by the Static Saints Tavern, one at the radio shack on Signal Hill, one in the cemetery. The city thinks it's bad reception.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Each rift has a crystal heart. Break the heart and the tear sews itself shut. Try not to fall in.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: What happens if I fall in?

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Then I get a very interesting letter.

Steps.Objective: Close the rift by the Static Saints Tavern: break its crystal heart.
Close the rift at the Signal Hill Radio Shack.
Close the rift in Grave Frequency Cemetery.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon (phone)
Lines.Text: The static just dropped an octave. You did it. Come back before the Saints start charging you rent.

Steps.Objective: Return to Iris Moon.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Three doors closed. The city sleeps better and has no idea why. That's the job.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Keep the shards. Forgewrights pay well for them, and Dante Rook pretends not to be impressed.

Quests.Title: Shades of Grave Frequency
Quests.Summary: Hollow Shades follow a dead frequency through Grave Frequency every night. Tune the old transmitter on Signal Hill to call them in, tear them apart, and then decide who gets to keep the transmitter.
Quests.Done: You called the shades with a dead frequency and put them down. Grave Frequency is quiet. Quiet is a lie, but a restful one.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Shades are like moths. Give them the right static and they come. The Saints' old transmitter can sing that static, if you ask it nicely.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: And if I ask it rudely?

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Then it sings louder. Wait for dark. Shades are shy, which is the only polite thing about them.

Steps.Objective: Go to the Signal Hill Radio Shack.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to tune the transmitter
Steps.Objective: Tune the old transmitter to the dead frequency.
Steps.Text: The speakers crackle. Somewhere in the cemetery, something answers.

Steps.Objective: Destroy the Hollow Shades drawn in by the signal.
Something heavier followed them. Kill the Hollows.

Steps.Name: THE TRANSMITTER
Steps.Text: The transmitter still hums with the dead frequency. The Static Saints would pay to have it back. Iris would rather it never sang again.

Steps.Prompt: Press E to smash the transmitter
Steps.Objective: Smash the transmitter.

Steps.Text: The dead frequency dies with a sound like a sigh.
You leave the transmitter humming. A Saints runner will collect it before dawn, and leave a tip.

Steps.Objective: Return to Iris Moon.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: The cemetery is quiet. Quiet is a lie, but it's a restful one.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Something else is listening now, though. Something that noticed you. Get some sleep. You'll want your face rested.

Quests.Title: The Mirror Duel
Quests.Summary: A Mirror Wraith has been wearing your face in the Inner World and waiting outside your own front door. Cross the Veil at Veyra Lofts and settle which of you gets to keep it.
Quests.Done: You beat your own reflection outside Veyra Lofts. The coat stayed with the original.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: There's a wraith walking the Inner World in your shape. Your shoulders. Your walk. Worse taste in coats.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Why me?

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: The Veil remembers whoever stares into it longest. You've been staring. It waits outside your lofts.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Hit it from the side. Wraiths copy everything except patience.

Steps.Objective: Go home to Veyra Lofts.
Hold the Third Eye and cross the Veil.

Lines.Speaker: Your Reflection
Lines.Text: You took your time. I've been keeping your bed warm.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: That's the creepiest thing anyone has said to me this week.

Lines.Speaker: Your Reflection
Lines.Text: It's only Tuesday.

Steps.Name: Your Reflection
Steps.Objective: Defeat your reflection. Strike from the side.
Hold the Third Eye to step back into the Outer City.
Return to Iris Moon.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Well? Which one of you came back?

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: The one with better taste in coats.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Good. I liked that coat. And I'm afraid the wraith you broke had friends in very high places.

FailIf.Message: You fled through the Veil. Your reflection keeps the house.

Quests.Title: The Queen of Glass
Quests.Summary: Every Mirror Wraith in the city answers to a queen holding court in the Inner World's Crystal Manor, wearing the face of whoever came last. Cross the Veil at the ruins and make sure your face is the last one she ever wears.
Quests.Done: The Mirror Wraith Queen shattered in the Inner World's Crystal Manor. The static went silent for a full minute.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: The wraith you broke was a courtier. The queen noticed. She's holding court in the Crystal Manor, behind the Veil.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: I'll hold the door open from here. You won't feel the drain. You'll feel everything else.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: The Crystal Manor. Where all of this started.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Things like to end where they started. It saves on travel.

Steps.Objective: Go to the Crystal Manor ruins in the northern Badlands.
Cross the Veil at the ruins: hold the Third Eye.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon (voice)
Lines.Text: That's not a manor anymore. That's a mirror pretending to be a building.

Lines.Speaker: Mirror Wraith Queen
Lines.Text: Another face for my collection. Yours has such interesting regrets.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: Collect this.

Steps.Objective: Step back out of the Inner World.
Return to Iris Moon.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: The static went silent for a full minute when she fell. I've never heard the city hold its breath before.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: The Order is yours, if you want it. We don't do robes. We do coffee, and terrible hours.

Lines.Speaker: Malik
Lines.Text: I already have terrible hours.

Lines.Speaker: Iris Moon
Lines.Text: Then you'll fit right in.

FailIf.Message: You slipped out of the Inner World and the queen's court closed behind you.
